rules.prepare:
# As in Debian: prefix the names of the functions in libpcre2-posix, so that # they don't clash with the ones in libc. export CFLAGS="$CFLAGS -Dregcomp=PCRE2regcomp -Dregexec=PCRE2regexec" export CFLAGS="$CFLAGS -Dregerror=PCRE2regerror -Dregfree=PCRE2regfree"
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure" \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --enable-pcre2-16 \ --enable-pcre2-32 \ --enable-jit \ --disable-pcre2grep-callout \ --disable-silent-rules \ --build="$AELTRA_BUILD_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE"
